description: This file contains implementation of classes and functions related to GLES 3.1 Vertex Array Objects, including VertexBinding and VertexAttribute classes, with methods for managing vertex attribute data and buffer interactions.

classes.name: VertexBinding
classes.description: Represents a vertex buffer binding with attributes like stride, divisor, offset, and a mask of bound attributes.

classes.name: VertexAttribute
classes.description: Represents a vertex attribute with properties such as format, pointer, offset, stride, and methods to update cached limits.

methods.name: VertexBinding::VertexBinding
methods.description: Default constructor initializing with zero bound attribute.

methods.name: VertexBinding::VertexBinding
methods.description: Constructor initializing with a specific bound attribute.

methods.name: VertexBinding::onContainerBindingChanged
methods.description: Handles changes in container binding, updating buffer if present.

methods.name: VertexAttribute::VertexAttribute
methods.description: Constructor initializing vertex attribute with a binding index.

methods.name: VertexAttribute::updateCachedElementLimit
methods.description: Calculates and updates the cached element limit based on buffer size, offset, and attribute size.

methods.name: ComputeVertexAttributeStride
methods.description: Computes the stride for a vertex attribute based on binding and attribute enabled state.

methods.name: ComputeVertexAttributeOffset
methods.description: Calculates the offset for a vertex attribute within a buffer.

methods.name: ComputeVertexBindingElementCount
methods.description: Determines the number of elements for a vertex binding considering divisor, draw count, and instance count.
